appdaemon_not_supported.description:
The Marketplace no longer manages AppDaemon apps. The apps it installed stay in place and AppDaemon keeps running them: {apps}.

Updates for these apps no longer come from the Marketplace. Keep them up to date yourself, outside of the Marketplace.
appdaemon_not_supported.title: AppDaemon apps are no longer managed by the Marketplace

legacy_dashboard_resources.description:
Your dashboard resources in YAML still load from `/hacsfiles`, the path HACS used. The Marketplace keeps serving it for compatibility, but installed resources use `/local/community`. Change these resources in your YAML configuration:

{resources}
legacy_dashboard_resources.title: Dashboard resources use an old path

The Marketplace no longer manages Python scripts. The scripts it installed stay in place and the Python scripts integration keeps running them: {scripts}.

Updates for these scripts no longer come from the Marketplace. Keep them up to date yourself, outside of the Marketplace.
python_scripts_not_supported.title: Python scripts are no longer managed by the Marketplace
